description.en: Open the Explorer at Monotremata to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开单孔类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Monotremata time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的单孔类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 陆家屯无惧兽耳与舌骨窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 125.5 Ma Lujiatun Unit window for near-complete holotype STM33-5 and inspect its ectotympanic, hyoid and limb evidence beside the revised early-therian matrix.
description.zh: 打开约 1.255 亿年前陆家屯单元的窗口，检查近完整正模 STM33-5 的鼓骨、舌骨与肢骨证据，并对照修订的早期兽亚纲形态矩阵。

limitations: STM33-5 is a near-complete Ambolestes zhoui holotype from the Lujiatun Unit of the Yixian Formation, Liaoning; the ectotympanic, hyoid and limb anatomy are specimen observations, while eutherian placement and the revised metatherian boundary come from the sampled character matrix.

The 126–125 Ma selector is a bounded formation-unit context, not a direct date for the skeleton, a global eutherian or metatherian FAD/LAD, a continuous lineage or direct ancestor claim. The CAO2024 frame supplies age context; map markers are bounded samples and do not establish exact specimen-to-map co-location.

title.zh: 非洲兽总目四大支模型窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 100 Ma display ceiling for the 16,397-base-pair placental molecular sample and inspect the Afrotheria-rooted topology as model context rather than a fossil locality.
description.zh: 打开约 1 亿年前的舍入显示上限，检查 16,397 个碱基对胎盘类分子样本及其以非洲兽总目为根的拓扑；这里是模型背景而非化石地点。

limitations: Murphy et al. analysed 19 nuclear and 3 mitochondrial genes from 42 placentals and two marsupial outgroups; the recovered four-clade topology and approximately 103 Ma basal estimate are molecular-model outputs, not observed fossil ancestry or an African ancestor location.

The route uses the package's rounded 100–0 Ma model-bounded Afrotheria range and does not convert it into a fossil FAD/LAD, exact crown origin, complete distribution or direct ancestry. The CAO2024 frame is an age-context reconstruction; any visual overlap with sampled records is not spatial co-registration.

title.zh: 拟兔伊尔丁曼哈组牙齿与跗骨窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 44.5 Ma early Middle Eocene window for holotype IVPP V20115 and referred teeth and tarsals from the lower Irdin Manha Formation, then inspect the body-size and ecomorphology comparisons.
description.zh: 打开约 4450 万年前早中始新世的窗口，检查下部伊尔丁曼哈组正模 IVPP V20115 及归入牙齿和跗骨，并查看体型与生态形态比较。

limitations: IVPP V20115 is the Mimolagus aurorae holotype right M3 from the lower Irdin Manha Formation of the Erlian Basin, with referred teeth and tarsals; tooth and tarsal morphology are direct observations, while body mass, cursoriality and tapiroid convergence are comparative estimates.

The 47.8–41.2 Ma interval is a bounded early Middle Eocene sample, not a global Glires FAD/LAD, a complete distribution, an uninterrupted lineage or direct ancestry. The CAO2024 frame supplies age context and map markers do not establish exact fossil-to-map co-location.
